full_judgment: they were shown as directors of the Company. Mr. Azmalul Hossain has given much emphasis on the decree obtained in Title Suit No. 138/03. They very number of the suit shows that it was filed only in the year 2003. two years after suit. In the absence of Bangladesh bank they obtained a decree by making M/S Homeland Toot wear Ltd. As defendant. So the question of taking into consideration of that decree does not arise to decide the question as to whether the action of Bangladesh Bank in rejecting the appeals of the petitioners was proper because that decree had no existence when the Bangladesh Bank decided those appeals. We have made a query to Mr. Azmulul Hossain as to why this suit was filed at such a belated stage. He admitted that there was no explanation for the delay. We have also noticed that the petitioner did not take any other steps such as they did not file any application before the Registrar, Joint Stock Company to strike out their names as directors and to rectify the record accordingly. Mr. Azmulul Hossain submitted that the record was rectified after the decree. Such rectification cannot be taken into consideration now.
